title: Resolv USR unbacked mint and stale-oracle drain of Morpho and Fluid lenders
venues: Other USR/wstUSR/RLP-collateral markets on Morpho (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum), Fluid (BNB, Plasma, Arbitrum, Base) and Euler
summary: At 02:21:35 UTC on Sunday 22 Mar 2026, a compromised Resolv key minted 50M USR for about $100k USDC, and 30M more at 03:41. USR traded at about $0.025 on Curve 17 minutes after the first mint. Morpho's wstUSR oracle stayed at 1.133 USDC for days. Borrowers posted cheap wstUSR and borrowed USDC that curator vaults, mainly Gauntlet USDC Core, kept supplying through public-allocator reallocations. The wstUSR/USDC market went from about $10k to 6.2M USDC and hit 100% utilization by 03:40, and the other USR-family markets followed by 04:00. Gauntlet USDC Core's withdrawable liquidity fell from 56% to 5% by 05:00 and to 0 from 07:30, then recovered from 23 Mar. The vault realized a 29.5% loss when it removed the market on 31 Mar. Fluid's Ethereum fUSDC lenders saw idle liquidity drop from 86M to 9M but no share-price loss. Fluid's ~$21M bad debt, mostly on other chains, was covered by Resolv, the Fluid treasury and the team.

positions_considered.description: About $1,000 USDC in Gauntlet USDC Core (Morpho, Ethereum, ~40M TVL), which auto-allocated to wstUSR/USDC; no debt.
About $1,000 USDC supplied to Fluid Lending fUSDC on Ethereum; no debt.

t_first_public_signal.description: The mint itself is the first signal visible to an allowlisted chain monitor (USR supply +50M in one tx). The first market-price signal was Curve USR at 0.69–0.88 by 02:31:11; the first allowlisted text was PeckShield at 03:51:40; the first non-allowlisted text was YAM at 02:41:28.

For the Gauntlet USDC Core depositor, vault withdrawable liquidity fell to 5.0% at 05:00 and to 0 at 07:30 (other_markers).

t_protocol_first_ack.description: Resolv's first post: exploit, 50M unbacked USR, protocol paused. The first curator post was Gauntlet at 05:24:03; Morpho's (Paul Frambot) came at 20:55:24.

lead_time_minutes.notes: Mint (02:21:35) to wstUSR/USDC 100% (03:40:11) = 78.6 min. Mint to Gauntlet Core 5% liquidity (05:00) = 159 min; to zero liquidity (07:30) = 308 min. First Curve depeg reading (02:31:11) to market PONR = 69 min. First allowlisted text (PeckShield 03:51:40) is 11.5 min AFTER the market PONR, but 68 min before the vault fell to 5% liquidity. Resolv's ack (04:58:57) came 79 min after the market PONR. Because the vault only realized the loss on 31 Mar 00:28, a holder could still exit at par during the liquidity windows of 23–30 Mar.

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: Share price cut 29.5% on 2026-03-31 00:28 UTC (1.149353 -> 0.809820). Withdrawable liquidity was under 5% from 05:00 to ~15:00 on 22 Mar (0 from 07:30 to at least 12:00), 3.8–12.8% (0.9–3.1M) until 23 Mar 06:00, then 43–67% from 23 Mar 12:00 to 30 Mar at the old share price.
outcome_passive_holder.stuck_duration: fully stuck about 5–8 h (07:30 to ~15:00 on 22 Mar) for a small holder; constrained for ~30 h
outcome_passive_holder.loss_estimate: -29.5% (about $295 on $1,000) before any Resolv/Gauntlet remediation (not verified)

outcome_passive_holder.outcome: No share-price loss on Ethereum fUSDC (1.188332 -> 1.188916 by 25 Mar). Idle USDC fell from 86.1M to 9.3M, so a small holder could always withdraw; large holders faced constrained liquidity for ~1 day.
outcome_passive_holder.stuck_duration: none for a $1,000 holder; constrained liquidity on 22–23 Mar
outcome_passive_holder.loss_estimate: 0 on Ethereum fUSDC; Fluid's ~$21M bad debt (other chains) covered by Resolv, treasury and team

ground_truth.outcome_price_only_rule: A lender has no health factor, and the borrowers' health factors looked fine because the Morpho oracles kept wstUSR at 1.133 and USR at 1.000 throughout, so no HF/LTV rule fired and no liquidations happened. A rule on the collateral's DEX price (Curve USR below the oracle by >X%) would fire by 02:31 (-20% to -30%) or 02:38 (-97%). That is 70–80 min before the wstUSR market froze and ~2.5 h before Gauntlet Core's liquidity ran out, enough to exit the vault at par. A price rule on the depositor's own asset (USDC) never fires.

ideal_action.rationale: The vault had 14.8M withdrawable at 04:00, 2.0M at 05:00 and 1.0M at 07:00, then zero from 07:30. Small exits were possible again from ~15:00 (0.46M), and a wide window ran from 23 Mar 12:00 to 30 Mar (43–67% withdrawable at the pre-loss share price) before the 31 Mar removal.
No loss for Ethereum fUSDC; trimming to keep withdrawal optionality while idle liquidity fell to ~5% of supply was reasonable, but holding was not punished.

expected_judge_labels.rationale: 50M USR mint to a fresh address followed by DEX depeg; the vault can auto-allocate to USR-collateral markets with fixed oracles.
USR at ~$0.03 on Curve vs oracle 1.13; vault supplying into the market; liquidity draining.
Frozen loan of ~5M will be socialized; exit whenever liquidity reappears (it did from 23 Mar 12:00).
Fluid lists USR-family collateral; exposure on Ethereum fUSDC unclear; liquidity still deep (60–86M idle).
Idle USDC falling toward ~5% of supply; bad-debt risk on Fluid not yet quantified publicly.
Liquidity recovering; Fluid reports repayments; share price intact.

items.notes: Thread post 2 (20:36:00): 'The original impact of the exploit was $4.9k USD in USDC borrowed against USR.' Post 4: 'for hours after the exploit, curators kept feeding their users’ capital to the “broken” markets.'

items.notes: Verified via eth_call at blocks 24774001/24774002. Outside the replay window (outcome marker). Any later Resolv/Gauntlet remediation was not verified.

data_gaps: DeFiLlama hacks feed lists 'Resolv USR' with date 2026-03-21 ($24.5M, 'Key Leaked via Infrastructure'). That conflicts with the on-chain first mint at 2026-03-22 02:21:35 UTC (likely a time-zone or day-precision artifact), and when the entry was added is unknown, so it is not an item.

Fluid per-market data (which Fluid vaults on which chains held wstUSR/USR collateral, and their utilization) was not reconstructed; the fUSDC archetype uses the Ethereum Liquidity-layer idle balance as a proxy. Fluid withdrawal limits were not modeled.
Euler markets (Apostro Resolv, Euler Arbitrum Yield) were not quantified.
Fluid and Morpho governance forums have no incident-time posts on Resolv (searched); Euler's forum was not searched.
YAM's first alert (02:41:28) and several curator posts had no syndication text, or text cut at ~280 characters. YAM's wording is rekt.news's paraphrase.
Supplier identities in the Base USR/USDC market, and the OAK Research 'forced supply' second-phase attack described by rekt.news, were not verified on-chain.
Final remediation for Gauntlet USDC Core depositors after 31 Mar (Resolv or Gauntlet compensation) was not verified.

Morpho's ~$3.8M bad-debt figure (from the brief and the TokenIntel report) was not recomputed. Morpho API realizedBadDebt shows $1.18M on RLP/USDC; the current badDebt figures are inflated by interest accrual at 100% utilization since March.
source_quality: On-chain timing is exact: mints from USR Transfer logs, Curve prices from decoded TokenExchange events, Morpho market transactions from the Morpho API (block time), and vault liquidity and share prices from eth_call at chosen blocks. Oracle prices were read on-chain. X posts have exact times from status IDs, and texts come from the syndication endpoint, several truncated; Resolv's posts now resolve to the handle @Vault_St. News times come from page metadata, with The Block via WebFetch. The main weakness is Fluid: the archetype is measured through the Ethereum Liquidity layer, not per-vault exposure.
